questions.prompt: Write the complete code to import NumPy as np, import Pandas as pd, import load_iris from sklearn.datasets, import Perceptron from sklearn.linear_model, load the Iris dataset into iris_data, select petal length and petal width into X, create y where Setosa (target 0) is 1 and all other species are 0, create perceptron_clf, train it with X and y, and predict [1.4, 0.3].
questions.modelAnswer: import numpy as np; import pandas as pd; from sklearn.datasets import load_iris; from sklearn.linear_model import Perceptron; iris_data = load_iris(); X = iris_data.data[:, (2, 3)]; y = (iris_data.target == 0).astype(int); perceptron_clf = Perceptron(); perceptron_clf.fit(X, y); print(perceptron_clf.predict([[1.4, 0.3]]))
questions.explanation: This tests the complete workflow: imports → load Iris → select features → create target → create Perceptron → train → predict.
